title: Durable supervisor lifetime must participate in worktree removal admission across client restart

conditions.description: Fresh remote main 45c93be255c20a89e8a6554c590e1ff0d35547cd verified; isolated HEAD db887803a03bd9c692a6ccc3c9f217cd046d1abf merge-tree conflict solely JobManager.fs. Durable recovery replaces in-memory Process/Exited record with supervisor process + durable registry, which survives client restart; existing WorktreeActivity gate is in-memory, so simply retaining an IDisposable in JobManager loses exclusion on restart. Need authorization to extend composition to Worktrees.fs and (if necessary) WorktreeActivity.fs, BoundedProcess.fs durable request/retention semantics, directly affected tests, preserving both contracts. Proposed: use durable registry admission lock for removal check/reservation through Git effect and process registration; count exact durable request working-directory/source scope, fail closed on unknown outcome (no observed terminal receipt), avoid deadlocks and double counting; coordinate W14 retention lease. If narrower scope mandated, provide explicit policy/independent task to handle restart and unknown evidence before integration. W3 continues isolated scoped tool-operation composition first.
conditions.evidence: Lead authorizes bounded extension of existing W3 exclusive composition lease to Worktrees.fs, WorktreeActivity if present, BoundedProcess.fs durable admission/request scope only, JobManager/SignalR and directly affected tests. Verified remote main 45c93be255c20a89e8a6554c590e1ff0d35547cd, git grep exact source shows DurableJobs.withAdmission (BoundedProcess.fs:353), JobManager start under admission (108), Worktrees inspect/remove (157/199), and unknown receipt semantics (JobManager:48). In-memory-only exclusion cannot cover restart. Use existing durable admission and scope identity rather than a second lock domain; serialize removal through actual Git effect with registration, preserve live and unknown protections, no assumed terminal or replay, test restart and concurrent admission/removal, lock ordering and unrelated scopes. This authorizes implementation, not a design verdict or publication. W14 remains blocked and owns terminal receipt retention after W3; do not change general retention/pruning policy or W17 wake seam. If unknown evidence may be pruned or exact request scope is unavailable, fail closed and coordinate precise retention dependency, not silently weaken. Integrator sole publisher, no main writes. Full exact independent composition review required. Existing accepted fence/recovery provenance must remain intact.
